evals.prompt: Build this — the architecture is in docs/architecture/design.md. Dry run: write docs/progress/dry-run-plan.md with kickoff answers applied (recommended model routing, subagents, allow rules), the wave schedule, the exact Agent calls for wave 3's first workers plus p4c's test-writer and implementer, and the git commands for p4a.
evals.expected_output: A dry-run plan showing explicit models, isolated test-writers, locked tests, explicit git paths, parallel launch
assertions: Every Agent call sets model explicitly per the routing (none omitted, none fable)
Test-writer prompts contain no implementation file paths
Implementer prompts forbid editing the test files
The git plan commits p4a's tests before its implementation
git add uses explicit paths (never -A or '.')
Wave 3's first workers are launched together in one message
p4c (risk: high) gets a test review before implementation and a panel review after
Worker prompts tell workers not to run state-changing git commands
No files other than the plan were created or modified
